player_prompt.intro:
Ko oonaa Player {player_id}. Ko oonaa tafaa Memory Game.
Ko golle maa ko oonaa yiɓɓinaa kadii ɓurɓe nder taabal, ko aduna e ɓesngu maa.
Caggal ma oonaa, ɓeydaa kadii ɗiɗi ɓamtare e noddire row e column ɓamtaare ɗum '[0 1 1 0]', ɗum kadii ɓurɗo ɗo nder row 0 e column 1, e kadii ɗiɗaɓo ɗo nder row 1 e column 0.
So kadii ɗiɗi yiɓɓe, a yiɓɓa e kadii ɗum ɓamtare. So ɓe yiɓataa, kadii ɗum ɓamtare ɓe ndaara, e.g. '.'.
Tafaa ɗum naatetee so kadii ɓurɓe ɗum yiɓɓe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na'ura je wala nafoore. {player_id} jaabake be laawol feere nder dabareji kareeji.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Jaɓɓorgo Daartol Walaa Ko Woni. {player_id} moodiɗo suɓii dabare je wala nder babal man.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Jaɓɓorgo Daartol. {player_id} suɓii kaar go'o ɗiɗi fuu.
invalid_move.already_matched: Jaɓɓorgo Daande Baɗal. {player_id} moodiɗo suɓii go'o malla kala kaarji ɗi ɗon hawti.

game_message.cards_match: Kadii ɓeydaa e Player {player_id} nder position [{r1} {c1}] e [{r2} {c2}] yiɓɓe!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kadii ɓeydaa e Player {player_id} ɓuri yiɓɓe. Kadii nder position [{r1} {c1}] e [{r2} {c2}] ɓuri {pos1} e {pos2} ɓuri.

outcome.draw: Ɓiɓɓe ɗiɗi fuu ɓe hawti limgal kaarji je ɗon fotta.
outcome.turn_limit: Ko wakkati ɓuri naatetee. Tafaa ɗum naatetee. Player 0 yiɓɓa {score_0} ɓuri, Player 1 yiɓɓa {score_1} ɓuri.
